shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: Grout renewal, silicone replacement and membrane repair address different parts of a shower. A surface repair can suit worn joints in an otherwise serviceable area, but it cannot be assumed to fix a concealed leak. Start with the symptoms and the condition of the shower before choosing the repair.

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: Local grout or seal renewal may suit isolated worn joints where tiles are stable, adjoining surfaces are serviceable and assessment has not identified a wider water or movement problem. The area still needs preparation and suitable materials. See
shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].target: 瓷砖稳定、相邻表面可用，且评估未发现更广泛水患或位移问题时，局部填缝或密封更新可能适合单独老化接缝。仍需基层准备和适当材料。请查看

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: A repair without tile removal is limited to what can be assessed and addressed at the surface. It cannot demonstrate that a concealed membrane is continuous, or repair damaged lining behind sound-looking tiles. Recurring dampness after earlier resealing is a reason to reassess the cause, not simply repeat the same treatment.
shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].target: 不拆砖维修限于表面可评估与处理的内容，不能证明隐蔽膜层连续，也不能修复看似完好瓷砖后方损坏墙衬。密封后反复潮湿应重新查明原因，不应简单重复同一处理。
管道渗漏与防水膜调查

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: Water outside the shower, damp adjoining walls or staining below can have more than one source. Supply or waste plumbing, fittings, junctions and the waterproofing assembly may need separate investigation. The location of a stain alone does not identify the failed component.
shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].target: 淋浴外积水、相邻墙潮湿或下方水渍可能来自多个水源。供排水管道、装置、交接及防水构造可能需分别调查。水渍位置本身不能识别失效部件。

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: Tell the assessor whether moisture appears only after shower use, is present when the shower is unused, or has changed after plumbing work. These observations help plan checks but do not establish a diagnosis. Appropriate licensed plumbing work is separate from tile-joint repairs.
shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].target: 请说明潮湿只在淋浴后出现、闲置时也存在，还是管道维修后有变化。这些观察帮助安排检查，但不能代替诊断。适当持牌管道工作与瓷砖接缝维修是独立范围。

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: Signs a leaking shower needs to be taken out of use
shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].target: 需要停止使用淋浴的渗漏迹象

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: Stop using the shower if water is escaping into adjoining rooms, damage is spreading, tiles are loose or surfaces are deteriorating. Avoid repeatedly running it to locate the leak. Keep clear of a damaged ceiling or unsafe surface and arrange assessment; water near electrical fittings needs urgent attention from the appropriate licensed trade.
shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].target: 水流入相邻房间、损坏扩大、瓷砖松动或表面劣化时，应停止使用淋浴，不要反复放水查漏。远离损坏天花板或不安全表面，安排评估；电气装置附近有水需相关持牌工种及时处理。

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: Dry visible surfaces only where it is safe, keep the affected area accessible, and note when dampness appears. Do not remove tiles or disturb concealed services to investigate it yourself. An assessment can define what needs further access and who should carry it out.
shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].target: 仅在安全情况下擦干可见表面，保持受影响区域可进入，并记录潮湿时间。不要自行拆砖或触碰隐蔽管线调查。评估会明确需进一步打开哪些位置及由谁负责。

shower-repair-options-guide.html/html[1].source: If only serviceable surface joints need renewal, agree the joint preparation and repair boundary.
